notes.title: Emberdrift v 1.1.1 is Now Live (Small Bugfixes)
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that would restart dialogue and get players stuck if they backtracked into certain boss rooms.
-Fixed a bug where a post processing effect would get stuck on in the final cutscene

notes.title: Emberdrift v 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Emberdrift v 1.1.0 is now live!
-Added a secret final world
-Added achievement for beating secret final boss
DEV NOTE: Gathering items from each of the backrooms (Cathedral, City, and Cave) and taking them to the timekeeper will unlock a secret final level and boss.  Get ready because this content is by far the hardest in the entire game.  

-Fixed a bug where the combo timer ran in between The Lost Cave and Nerva.
-Fixed a bug with the Nemesis Hourglass that would cause it to make the combo timer run in shops.
DEV NOTE: Hopefully this should make it easier to reach the 1000 combo achievement!

-Prevented Enemy Sprite Skins from updating while off screen
DEV NOTE: This should improve performance on some systems

notes.title: Small Patch 1.0.4.2
notes.content: Fixed main character being called "Default" in dialogue.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4.1
